tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is seeking 30 billion dollars as competition intensifies to raise money for artificial intelligence development, reported by Bloomberg.
The UK has adopted 44 artificial intelligence healthcare recommendations to strengthen device monitoring and safety standards, confirmed by MLex.
New York City Council held a hearing to examine artificial intelligence safety risks and their potential impact on the city, confirmed by NBC News.
A former OpenAI researcher has warned of artificial intelligence threats while Jon Stewart mocked a Trump strategy on artificial intelligence self-regulation, reported by inkl.
Experts are calling for artificial intelligence regulation and warning of a dystopian future, reported by Semafor, though the White House downplays regulation citing benefits for Chinese firms.
Free every hour.
